name: Kesar Terminals & Infrastructure Limited
summary: Kesar Terminals & Infrastructure Ltd. offers crucial services for the warehousing and movement of bulk liquid goods. The company supports international traders by facilitating the import and export of a wide array of fluid commodities, encompassing items like refined petroleum products, castor oil, various chemicals, crude oil, petrochemicals, and edible oils. This firm commenced operations on January 21, 2008, and its central office is situated in Mumbai, India.
